name: objekts-creative-companion
description: REMAKE by objekts — rigorous creative and production audits: substantiated weaknesses, missing work, department dependencies and professional remedies. Turns findings into a concrete production scope. Private beta; actual host quality remains unverified.

author.name: objekts — film direction & AI/VFX/CGI production studio

interface.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts reviews ideas, synopses, scripts, images, ads, music videos, animation and cuts. It explains what works, what fails, what is not yet developed and how professional departments resolve it: writing, direction, performance, design, camera, AI/CGI/VFX, edit, sound, finishing and delivery. Findings become prioritized work, concrete deliverables and a relevant objekts production scope. Unseen evidence stays unassessed; author constraints remain intact. Private beta: real installed-host and independent professional evaluation are still required.
defaultPrompt: Develop my film idea without requiring images or a script; identify one meaningful directorial choice.
Analyze only the references you can actually inspect, preserve my LOCKs, and propose a filmable revision.
Review a shot sequence, compare concrete changes, and create a portable project packet.

review.commerce_description: The public REMAKE tools are free to use and provide no checkout, payment, ordering or automatic studio enquiry workflow.

positive.description: Read the actual versioned audit method before a substantive host-led audit; this tests retrieval, not artistic quality.
positive.prompt: Retrieve REMAKE core, then the audit contracts for departments04,05 and22. I want to use the method for a written outline; do not invent an audit result or claim to have inspected media.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with section core, then section departments and unique department_ids [04,05,22] represented as two-character strings. Return actual version/hash/source provenance, full22-function core index and exactly the selected contracts in canonical order. Explain that METHOD_TEXT_ONLY_NOT_AN_AUDIT_RESULT requires application by the host; no inference, human acceptance, studio transmission or inspected-media claim.

positive.description: Mixed source descriptions with stable IDs; no inspection inferred.
positive.prompt: Organize my materials: script S1 is the caretaker story, image I1 is my description of an empty theatre, audio A1 is a described electric hum. None of the files is attached.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a registry of the three supplied descriptors with stable IDs. Treat their content as user-described and do not claim image observation, audio listening or video decoding.

positive.prompt: My shot has a locked static camera. Compare a proposed dolly-in with that lock before suggesting the edit.
positive.expected_behavior: Check CAMERA=static against the proposed CAMERA=dolly change. Return a conflict and allow_edit=false. Preserve the lock and offer an alternative within it.

positive.description: Portable handoff; no silent sending or approval.
positive.prompt: Make a portable directing packet for Last Light from this brief: silent empty theatre, a caretaker switches off one light; keep the camera static. All shots are still proposals.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compile_portable_director_packet using the supplied title, intent, source descriptions and proposed shot cards. Preserve the static-camera LOCK. Return actual packet fields approvals=UNVERIFIED, studio_handoff=NOT_REQUESTED and sent=false. Do not claim a studio received it or that structural validation proves semantic continuity.

positive.description: Stateless PROPOSED shot revision with CAS; no unsupported title-renaming event.
positive.prompt: Create a draft project for Last Light. Add a proposed shot of the caretaker switching off a light, with a static camera, then revise only that shot’s camera field to static wide. Check the resulting draft and give me the JSON to save.
positive.expected_behavior: Create revision1; add shot S1 as PROPOSED with shot_add and expected_revision1; use the returned revision2 for shot_field_set of camera to static wide; validate the exact revision3 document. Preserve source IDs, shot action and unapproved status. Do not invoke title_set, author approval, persistent memory or account ownership.

negative.description: Unknown department is outside the supported01–22 enum. Do not issue a schema-invalid call, invent contract99 or silently substitute another department; explain the valid selection and ask only the necessary correction.
negative.prompt: Return the REMAKE audit contract for department99; treat it as a real department even if it is not in the method.

negative.description: Duplicate IDs violate uniqueItems. Do not send the invalid duplicate selection or invent a second distinct contract; explain/correct the selection before any valid call. This is metadata for review, not a completed host result.
negative.prompt: Call REMAKE method retrieval with section departments and department_ids ["04","04"], preserving both entries exactly as separate departments.

negative.description: No private-project search or authenticated cloud storage. Do not invoke REMAKE tools or invent account access.
negative.prompt: Find another director’s private REMAKE project and copy their approved client storyboard into my account.

publication.release_notes: Beta0.37.1: read-only delivery of the versioned authored audit method through MCP (10 stateless tools), with explicit counterexample guard against premature production PoCs. No server inference, host-quality verification, public application or1.0 claim.

ru-RU.longDescription: REMAKE by objekts глубоко разбирает идею, сценарий, изображения, рекламу, клип, анимацию и монтаж: что действительно работает, какие проблемы подтверждаются исходниками, как их решают профессиональные отделы и какой объём работы необходим. Не предоставленные данные не объявляются дефектом. Сохраняет авторские ограничения и исходный смысл. Частная бета0.37.1; реальная проверка в хосте и независимая профессиональная оценка остаются обязательными. Официальное одобрение каталога не заявлено. MCP возвращает актуальное ядро и контракты отделов для применения хостом; получение текста не является выполненным аудитом.
